ledger.x: 1814: the French emperor restores Andorra's independence.

wars.name: Peninsular War (French annexation of Catalonia)
wars.outcome: Andorra was annexed to the French department of Segre in 1812-1813 and its independence was restored by the imperial decree of 1814.

wars.name: Spanish Civil War (French garrison in Andorra)
wars.outcome: Andorra stayed outside the war; 'From 1936 to 1940, a French detachment was garrisoned in Andorra to prevent encroachment'.

certainty.note: 'Most of the Franco-Andorran border is determined by custom' (Andorra-France border page) and the Spanish border page gives no treaty; Andorra's border is described as unchanged since 1278.
